newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural calls for care in liberalising sector.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural calls for care in liberalising sector.

text.p: Spain's Gas Natural chairman Pere Duran said on Tuesday a lot of thought must go into the liberalisation of Spain's gas sector due to its unusual structure and tariff system compared with other European nations.
"It will be necessary to be very prudent (in the liberalisation) and we must have opening levels similar to those in Europe," Duran said at a press conference prior to the shareholders meeting.
Duran said the EC directive on liberalisation initially required that some 30 percent of the consumer market should be open to competition.
But with industrial supply comprising 80 percent of the market, this would leave an overexposed consumer market, he said.
Duran said extreme care must also be taken with tariffs which are currently based on fuel levels.
"The logical thing would be a tariff sytem based on real costs and not on the energy that it replaces," he said.
With respect to the future, Duran reiterated that the gas supplier would pursue an extremely aggressive exploration policy.
On investments, he said the company would be interested in being involved in the telecommunications sector and products that were independent of electricity.
He did not rule out the possibility of participating in Retevision once the privatisation process had ended.
